On $t_c\ne0$ the affine fibre equation gives $x'_i/x_i^a$ independent of the $X$ coordinates. Its expression in the two charts is therefore $t_c^{v'_i-av_i}$ times a holomorphic unit of $t_c$, including zero. This proves \eqref{pub:I:eq:B2-3}. Taking logarithms shows that its winding is in $\Lambda_{\rm tor}=\mathbb Z\widehat w+\mathbb Zd$. Changing a lift adds $(I-A_0)\Lambda=\Lambda_{\rm tor}$, so the vanishing of its class in $\bar\Lambda=\Lambda/\Lambda_{\rm tor}$ is intrinsic. Thus every extending translation has the stated integral winding and holomorphic unit factor.
